entries.label: IPP (5v5)
entries.desc: Individual points percentage: the share of 5v5 goals scored with the player on ice on which he had a point.

entries.label: Points pace
entries.desc: Points per game times the season's games.

entries.label: Unblocked attempts
entries.desc: Individual Fenwick: goals, shots on goal and misses.

entries.label: Shot attempts
entries.desc: Individual Corsi: every attempt, blocked ones included.

entries.label: ixG
entries.desc: Individual expected goals, all situations (sum of the xG of the player's unblocked attempts).

entries.label: Expected Fenwick sh%
entries.desc: ixG per unblocked attempt: shot quality.

entries.label: Shooting talent
entries.desc: Shrunk finishing: goals above xG on a manned net regressed toward the league by the stabilisation constant of finishing, gax x attempts / (attempts + k).

entries.label: High-danger attempts / 60
entries.desc: Unblocked attempts with xG of 0.20 or more, per 60.

entries.label: Rebound attempts / 60
entries.desc: Attempts within 3 s of a team-mate's or own attempt.

entries.label: Rush attempts / 60
entries.desc: Attempts within 4 s of a neutral- or defensive-zone event.

entries.label: Wrist / snap share
entries.desc: Share of unblocked attempts that were wrist or snap shots.

entries.label: Slap share
entries.desc: Share of unblocked attempts that were slap shots.

entries.label: Tip / deflection share
entries.desc: Share of unblocked attempts that were tips or deflections.

entries.label: CF / 60
entries.desc: On-ice shot attempts for per 60 at 5v5.

entries.label: CF%
entries.desc: On-ice share of shot attempts at 5v5.

entries.label: FF%
entries.desc: On-ice share of unblocked attempts at 5v5.

entries.label: SF / 60
entries.desc: On-ice shots on goal for per 60.

entries.label: SA / 60
entries.desc: On-ice shots on goal against per 60.

entries.label: SF%
entries.desc: On-ice share of shots on goal.

entries.label: On-ice sh%
entries.desc: Team shooting % with the player on ice.

entries.label: On-ice sv%
entries.desc: Team save % with the player on ice.

entries.label: On-ice G - xG
entries.desc: On-ice goal differential minus expected goal differential.

entries.label: CF% rel
entries.desc: CF% on ice minus the team's CF% without him (in his games).

entries.label: RAPM offence
entries.desc: Regularised adjusted plus-minus: the player's isolated effect on his team's 5v5 xG for per 60 (teammates, opponents, zone starts and score controlled; ridge with multi-season priors).

entries.label: RAPM defence
entries.desc: Isolated effect on xG against per 60, signed so that higher is better (fewer chances allowed).

entries.label: RAPM net
entries.desc: Offence plus defence: isolated xG differential per 60.

entries.label: RAPM offence SE
entries.desc: Posterior standard error of RAPM offence.

entries.label: RAPM defence SE
entries.desc: Posterior standard error of RAPM defence.

entries.label: RAPM net SE
entries.desc: Posterior standard error of RAPM net (with the offence-defence covariance).

entries.label: RAPM CF
entries.desc: Isolated effect on shot attempts for per 60.

entries.label: RAPM CA
entries.desc: Isolated effect on shot attempts against per 60 (higher is better).

entries.label: RAPM power play
entries.desc: Isolated effect on PP xG for per 60.

entries.label: RAPM penalty kill
entries.desc: Isolated effect on PK xG against per 60 (higher is better).

entries.label: OZ start %
entries.desc: Offensive-zone share of the 5v5 faceoffs (O + D) taken with the player on ice.

entries.label: DZ start share
entries.desc: Defensive-zone share of all 5v5 on-ice faceoffs.

entries.label: OZ faceoffs on ice
entries.desc: 5v5 offensive-zone faceoffs with the player on ice.

entries.label: DZ faceoffs on ice
entries.desc: 5v5 defensive-zone faceoffs with the player on ice.

entries.label: QoC (TOI)
entries.desc: TOI-weighted mean 5v5 TOI per game of the opponents faced.

entries.label: QoT (TOI)
entries.desc: TOI-weighted mean 5v5 TOI per game of the team-mates on ice.

entries.label: QoC (xGF%)
entries.desc: TOI-weighted mean xGF% of the opponents faced.

entries.label: QoT (xGF%)
entries.desc: TOI-weighted mean xGF% of the team-mates on ice.

entries.label: 5v5 TOI share
entries.desc: Share of the team's 5v5 time in his games.

entries.label: Avg shift (s)
entries.desc: Mean shift length in seconds (stint segments joined).

entries.label: Top speed
entries.desc: Fastest skating burst (mph), NHL EDGE (2021-22 onward).

entries.label: 20+ mph bursts
entries.desc: Skating bursts of 20 mph or more.

entries.label: OZ time %
entries.desc: Share of 5v5 time in the offensive zone (EDGE).

entries.label: Rink value (GAR)
entries.desc: Goals above replacement: RAPM offence and defence at 5v5, power play, penalty kill, shooting talent, penalties and faceoffs, against a replacement-level skater.

entries.label: Rink value (WAR)
entries.desc: GAR in wins (goals per win from the season's scoring).

entries.label: Projected points
entries.desc: Rest-of-season projection: points so far plus remaining games times a points rate regressed toward the position average by the rate's stabilisation constant.

entries.label: Projected goals
entries.desc: Goals so far plus remaining games times a regressed goal rate.

entries.label: Projected xGF%
entries.desc: 5v5 xGF% regressed toward 50 % by its stabilisation constant.

entries.label: Starts
entries.desc: Games started (in net for the first event).

entries.label: xGA / 60
entries.desc: Expected goals faced per 60 (difficulty of the workload).

entries.label: xG per attempt
entries.desc: Mean xG of the unblocked attempts faced.

entries.label: High-danger share
entries.desc: Share of unblocked attempts faced that were high danger.

entries.label: Start share
entries.desc: Share of the team's games started.

entries.label: Back-to-back starts
entries.desc: Starts on the second night of a back-to-back.

entries.label: Wins
entries.desc: Decisions credited to the goalie with the most time in the game.

entries.label: Quality start %
entries.desc: Starts with sv% above the league average (or .885 on 20 shots or fewer).

entries.label: GSAx
entries.desc: xG of the unblocked attempts faced minus goals allowed (positive = better).

entries.label: dFSv%
entries.desc: Unblocked save % minus expected unblocked save %.

entries.label: Expected FSv%
entries.desc: 1 minus mean xG per unblocked attempt faced (shot difficulty).

entries.label: GSAx low danger
entries.desc: GSAx on attempts with xG under 0.08.

entries.label: GSAx high danger
entries.desc: GSAx on attempts with xG 0.20 or more.

entries.label: Low-danger sv%
entries.desc: Save % on low-danger shots on goal.

entries.label: Medium-danger sv%
entries.desc: Save % on medium-danger shots on goal.

entries.label: High-danger sv%
entries.desc: Save % on high-danger shots on goal.

entries.label: GSAx wrist / snap
entries.desc: GSAx on wrist and snap shots.

entries.label: Rebound rate
entries.desc: Saves followed within 3 s by another attempt by the shooting team, per save.

entries.label: GSAx (shrunk)
entries.desc: GSAx regressed toward zero by its stabilisation constant.

entries.label: GSAx (model)
entries.desc: GSAx from the expected-goals model's own table (empty nets out).

entries.label: EDGE high-danger sv%
entries.desc: NHL EDGE save % from high-danger areas.

entries.label: EDGE long-range sv%
entries.desc: NHL EDGE save % from long range.

entries.label: Rating
entries.desc: Team strength (goal differential per game against an average opponent) or, without the model, xG differential per game.

entries.label: Power play
entries.desc: Expected goals for per 60 on the power play.

entries.label: Goaltending
entries.desc: Team goals saved above expected per 60.

model.label: Expected goals (xG)
model.desc: The probability that an unblocked attempt becomes a goal (LightGBM) from distance, angle, shot type, rebound (time and angle change since the previous attempt), rush (time since a neutral- or defensive-zone event), time since and type and location of the previous event, strength, score state and an arena adjustment for scorer bias (seasons before 2023-24); cross-fitted by season so no shot is scored by a model that saw it; benchmarked against MoneyPuck's xGoal (credit: xG benchmark data from MoneyPuck.com). When the model does not score a season the build uses a logistic fallback fitted on the season's own attempts and says so (xg_source).

model.label: Shooting talent
model.desc: Goals above expected per unblocked attempt, regressed toward the league by the stabilisation constant of finishing (most of a season's goals-above-xG is noise).

model.label: GSAx
model.desc: Goals saved above expected: the xG of the unblocked attempts a goalie faces minus the goals he allows, overall, by danger band (xG under 0.08, 0.08-0.20, 0.20+), by shot type and by strength; empty-net goals excluded.

model.label: On-ice rates
model.desc: Shot attempts, unblocked attempts, shots, goals and xG for and against per 60 with the player on the ice at 5v5, on the power play and short-handed; the adjusted versions are score- and venue-adjusted (each event weighted by how its score state and venue inflate or deflate rates league-wide).

model.label: RAPM
model.desc: Regularised adjusted plus-minus: a ridge regression on 5v5 stints where every skater has an offence and a defence coefficient, with team-mates, opponents, zone starts, score state and home ice controlled, and priors from earlier seasons; the coefficients are isolated xG for and against per 60.

model.label: Rink value
model.desc: Goals above replacement (GAR) and wins (WAR): RAPM offence and defence, power play and penalty kill, shooting talent, penalties drawn and taken and faceoffs, in goals over a replacement-level player (the level of the players outside each team's regular lineup); goalies from GSAx against replacement goaltending.

model.label: Lines
model.desc: Forward trios and defence pairs from the shift charts: every 5v5 stint with three forwards and two defencemen on a side counts toward that line and that pair.

model.label: Team strength
model.desc: Score- and venue-adjusted xG and shot rates by strength, special teams, a goaltending component with the expected starter as an input, and schedule effects (rest, travel, back-to-backs).

model.label: Game model
model.desc: Goals for each side from the team-strength components, starters and context, with correlation, empty-net and late-game effects; outputs the win probability, regulation result, overtime and shootout probabilities, puck line and total.

model.label: Win probability
model.desc: A Markov model of the remaining goals at every event from score, time, strength and the pre-game expectation; without it the page uses a Poisson model of the remaining goals at the pre-game rates (labelled).

model.label: Season simulation
model.desc: The remaining schedule simulated game by game (84 games from 2026-27), points (win 2, OT / SO loss 1), the NHL tiebreak procedure, divisional and wild-card seeding, best-of-seven series, the Presidents' Trophy and the draft lottery; magic numbers and next-game odds.

model.label: Award races
model.desc: Hart, Vezina, Norris, Calder, Art Ross, Maurice Richard and Selke probabilities from the projected season and a fit on verified past winners.

model.label: Percentiles
model.desc: 100 = best, reversed where lower is better; placed against the qualified pool (skaters: 250 minutes at 5v5 per 82 team games, prorated; goalies: a quarter of the team's minutes) after shrinking the value toward the pool mean with the metric's stabilisation constant: (n v + k m) / (n + k); a metric needs its sample floor (50 minutes at 5v5, 20 shots, 50 faceoffs, 20 PP or PK minutes, 100 unblocked attempts faced) before it gets a percentile. Rink value (GAR, WAR and their parts) needs 200 minutes (goalies 600) per 82-game schedule, not prorated: early in a season nearly everyone is within a few hundredths of a win of zero and one game would reorder them. pct_pos compares forwards with forwards and defencemen with defencemen.

model.label: Stabilisation
model.desc: The sample at which split-half reliability reaches 0.7: r(n) = n / (n + k), n_0.7 = 0.7 k / 0.3 (k fitted per metric over seasons).

model.label: Strength states
model.desc: 5v5: five skaters a side with both goalies in net; PP / SH: the player's team has more / fewer skaters; other: 4v4, 3v3, empty net. Regular-season shootouts are excluded from every count.

model.label: Game score
model.desc: Three stars: 0.75 G + 0.7 A1 + 0.55 A2 + 0.075 SOG + 0.05 BLK + 0.15 penalties drawn - 0.15 taken + 0.01 FOW - 0.01 FOL + 0.05 CF - 0.05 CA + 0.15 GF - 0.15 GA (5v5 on-ice terms); goalies -0.75 GA + 0.1 saves.

model.label: Strengths and needs
model.desc: Each club's centres, wings, defence and goalies and its 5v5 offence, 5v5 defence, power play and penalty kill, valued as projected GAR over a full season (rest-of-season GAR per 60 x projected ice time) and placed against the league (A top 20 %, B, C, D, F bottom 20 %); trade targets ranked by what each would add in the club's depth chart.

model.label: Trade simulator
model.desc: Players move; incoming players take ice time from the lowest-rated players at their position (a better goalie takes the starts), outgoing minutes go to the next players up, any shortfall at replacement. The change in the rotation's GAR per 60 x minutes shifts the club's rating in goals a game; points and odds come from re-running the season simulation at shifted ratings. The salary cap is not checked.

model.label: Aging curve
model.desc: The change in GAR per 60 from one season to the next by age (delta method on consecutive seasons, minute-weighted), centred on the all-ages mean and shrunk; used for next season's value in the trade simulator.

model.label: Valuation (multi-season)
model.desc: A player's projected on-field value in WAR over the rest of this season and the next three, discounted 0.9 a season: rest-of-season GAR per 60 aged on the ageing curve, times projected minutes, availability (games-played share, regressed) and survival (the chance he is still an NHL regular); a 10th-90th percentile band from simulated careers. Not contracts or the salary cap.

model.label: VORP (positional)
model.desc: Value over the replacement level at the player's own position (C, LW, RW, D, G): the minute-weighted GAR per 60 of players outside the league's top N at that position by ice time.

model.label: Scarcity index
model.desc: How much better a position's starters are than its replacement level, relative to all skaters (1 = average; above 1, good players at that position are harder to replace).

model.label: Survival
model.desc: The chance a player who is an NHL regular this season (games played >= 25 % of team games; goalies 12 %) is still one next season, from a logistic regression on age, his rate and his minutes over every pair of completed seasons.

model.label: Availability
model.desc: The expected share of his team's games a skater plays: games played this season and the last two, regressed to the league mean of regulars with 30 pseudo-games, less the games an injury is expected to cost.

model.label: Trade grade
model.desc: A club's share of the value a trade moved, rescaled to two sides: A >= 65 %, B >= 55 %, C 45-55 %, D >= 35 %, F below; 'minor' when the deal moved under 0.25 WAR. Graded at the time (valuation as of the trade date, no hindsight) and now (realised since + what is still projected in the original window).

model.label: Pick-value curve
model.desc: What a draft slot is worth: the mean discounted WAR of each overall pick over its first seven seasons (2010-2019 drafts, picks who never played count zero), fitted with a smooth decreasing curve; future picks of unknown slot are valued at the round's average, discounted by the seasons until the draft.

model.label: Realised value
model.desc: Since a trade: the player's GAR per 60 that season x his minutes for the new club after the trade date / goals per win.

model.label: Fantasy points (ours)
model.desc: Our own default scoring, not any platform's: G 2, A 1.5, +/- 0.5, PPP 0.5, SOG 0.3, HIT 0.2, BLK 0.4; goalies W 4, GA -1, SV 0.2, SO 3. Every weight can be changed on the page.

model.label: Fantasy VOR
model.desc: Rest-of-season points over the best player left at the position after a greedy draft of twelve standard rosters (C 2, LW 2, RW 2, D 4, UTIL 1, G 2, bench 4).

model.label: Tiers
model.desc: Groups of similar value: a new tier starts where the drop to the next player is among the largest 10 % of drops in the top 240 (at least three a tier).

model.label: Buy low / sell high
model.desc: Players whose results run far from what their chances support: goals 2+ away from finishing-adjusted expected goals or an on-ice 5v5 PDO beyond 0.950 / 1.050, with the projection 0.4+ points a game away from their pace; goalies with GSAx 4+ goals from what their save talent implies.

model.label: PP unit
model.desc: PP1 / PP2 from each skater's recency-weighted power-play minutes ranked on his club (1-5 PP1, 6-10 PP2).

model.label: Streaming goalies
model.desc: Goalies outside the top 24 ranked by this week's projected starts x matchups: start probability from recent start share (a back-to-back's second game moved to the backup by the fitted ratio), wins from the game model's win probability, goals against from team defence, opponent offence and save talent.
